city.name: Cincinnati
city.regionLabel: Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky and a sensible drive

events.title: Oktoberfest Zinzinnati
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.priceLabel: Free admission; food and drink extra
events.description: The self-proclaimed world's largest Oktoberfest outside Munich returns to the riverfront with a 300-foot beer tent, the World's Largest Chicken Dance, and a stein-hoisting contest.

events.title: Cincinnati Reds vs. Chicago Cubs
events.description: The Reds close out their home slate against the rival Cubs, with September standings still very much in play for both NL Central clubs.

events.title: Jack White
events.description: The former White Stripes frontman brings his raw, blues-driven rock to the riverfront amphitheater for a phone-free show, locking devices away for an unfiltered live set.

events.title: Cincinnati Ballet — Kaplan New Works Series
events.description: Four internationally recognized choreographers premiere brand-new, visual-art-inspired works in this intimate theater — a rare first look before the pieces have a performance history.

events.title: Zoofari Knights — An Evening of Tails and Scales
events.description: The Zoo's biggest fundraiser of the year turns Vine Street Village into a medieval-themed adults' evening of cocktails, animal encounters, and live music benefiting conservation work.

events.title: Chico Bean
events.description: One-third of the popular 85 South Show crew headlines two Friday shows, bringing his high-energy crowd work and sketch-honed stand-up north of the city.

events.title: Paint and Sip at Krohn Conservatory
events.description: Paint among the palms inside the historic glasshouse during a guided evening art class, held while the conservatory's botanical-art fall show is in full swing.

events.title: Box Park Beats
events.description: A free weekly Friday live-music series on the riverfront plaza, wrapping up its summer run with local bands and skyline views just across the river from Oktoberfest.

events.title: Air Force Marathon Weekend — Friday 5K
events.venue: National Museum of the U.S. Air Force
events.description: The evening-before 5K kicks off the 30th-anniversary Air Force Marathon weekend, staged right on the grounds of the national Air Force museum.

events.title: Underwater Pumpkin GLOW
events.description: Hundreds of carved, glowing pumpkins appear among the tanks as the aquarium opens its fall season, mashing up Halloween decor with underwater exploration for families.

events.title: Oktoberfest Zinzinnati
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.priceLabel: Free admission; food and drink extra
events.description: Peak-day energy at the region's signature beer festival, with the Running of the Wieners, Gemütlichkeit Games, and a massive 300-foot fest tent on the riverfront.

events.title: Cincinnati Reds vs. Chicago Cubs
events.description: A Saturday-night ballpark date against the Cubs, one of the last home games of the regular season on the riverfront.

events.title: Cincinnati Pops — The Music of Hans Zimmer
events.description: The Pops tackle the brass-heavy, thundering film scores of Hans Zimmer — Gladiator, The Dark Knight and more — inside the acoustically celebrated Springer Auditorium.

events.title: The Great Gatsby (Broadway in Cincinnati)
events.description: The Tony-winning musical take on Fitzgerald's jazz-age classic swings through town with lavish period choreography and an original pop-infused score.

events.title: HEIST
events.venue: Moe and Jack's Place — The Rouse Theatre, Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park
events.description: A new heist comedy-thriller by Arun Lakra gets its regional premiere on the Playhouse's mainstage, co-produced with two other major regional theaters.

events.title: Corner of the Sky: The Songs of Stephen Schwartz
events.description: A world-premiere musical revue traces Stephen Schwartz's songbook from "Corner of the Sky" through "Defying Gravity," built around a cast of Broadway veterans.

events.title: Make Believe
events.description: Four adult siblings confront the ghosts of their childhood in the attic playroom of their old family home, in this regional-premiere mystery from playwright Bess Wohl.

events.title: Network
events.venue: Otto M. Budig Theater, Cincinnati Shakespeare Company
events.description: The "mad as hell" 1976 film satire of TV news gets a stage adaptation, turning its still-relevant media critique into a sharp night of live theater.

events.title: Cincinnati Bearcats vs. Miami RedHawks — Battle for the Victory Bell
events.description: Ohio's oldest rivalry trophy game moves to FC Cincinnati's soccer stadium for the first time ever, a one-off venue switch for a border-war matchup over a century old.

events.title: Ohio Renaissance Festival — Pirates Weekend
events.description: Sea shanties, a full-size pirate ship, and swashbuckling stage combat take over the festival grounds for International Talk Like a Pirate Day weekend.

events.title: Derrick Stroup — Running Hot Tour
events.description: The rising country-rock singer-songwriter brings his "Running Hot" tour to the ornate, historic Taft stage for an 18-and-over night downtown.

events.title: Chico Bean
events.description: Two more sold-out-caliber sets from the 85 South Show comic on his busiest club night of the weekend.

events.title: Norwood International Art Show
events.venue: Floral Avenue (between Washington Ave & Smith Rd)
events.description: Now in its fifth year, this juried outdoor show lines a Norwood street with 20-30 local and international artists plus hands-on block-printing, pottery, and tie-dye stations for kids.

events.title: The City Flea
events.description: Cincinnati's original curated flea market fills the park across from Music Hall with vintage finds, local makers, plants, and food trucks — a reliable OTR Saturday tradition.

events.title: A Fair of the Arts
events.description: Local artists set up across the park for this free evening art fair, with a free concert and food and drink vendors making it a laid-back east-side community hang.

events.title: Findlay Market Saturday
events.description: Ohio's oldest continuously operated public market hits peak Saturday energy, with produce stands, butchers, global food stalls, and buskers filling the historic sheds.

events.title: Outdoor Building Tour of Cincinnati Music Hall
events.description: Friends of Music Hall lead a guided walk around the exterior of the landmark 1878 Venetian Gothic concert hall, covering its architecture, restoration, and backstory.

events.title: Yayoi Kusama: All the Eternal Love I Have for the Pumpkins
events.description: Step into Kusama's mirrored room packed with polka-dotted yellow pumpkins, one of the most photographed installations to visit the museum, on view through mid-October.

events.title: Witness to the Journey: Matt Herron and the Deep South, 1965
events.description: Civil-rights-era photographer Matt Herron's 1965 Deep South images anchor this new exhibit, pairing raw documentary photography with the Freedom Center's mission.

events.title: LEGO Jurassic World: The Exhibition
events.venue: Cincinnati Museum Center at Union Terminal
events.description: Life-size LEGO dinosaurs and movie-recreated brick builds take over the art deco train station, a hands-on hit for dino-obsessed kids.

events.title: A Living Museum of Botanical Splendor
events.description: The conservatory's fall show pairs its permanent rainforest and desert rooms with a rotating art-meets-botany display on plant diversity and conservation.

events.title: SOFTlab: Gravity's Rainbow
events.description: A floating, color-shifting installation of suspended forms hangs over the CAC's lobby — a striking piece visible even before you head upstairs to the galleries.

events.title: 2026 Truth & Inspiration Showcase
events.description: Twenty-four local artists commissioned through ArtsWave's Inspire Artist Grant show original work in this closing-weeks showcase spotlighting Cincinnati's own creative talent.

events.title: Air Force Marathon Weekend — Marathon, Half & 10K
events.venue: National Museum of the U.S. Air Force
events.description: The 30th-anniversary edition of this Boston-qualifying race draws thousands of runners from 18 countries onto the museum grounds, with the Air Force Thunderbirds headlining the flyover.

events.title: Dayton Hispanic Heritage Festival
events.description: Latin music, food, and dance fill the riverfront park for a day-into-night celebration of Dayton's Hispanic community, part of the city's official Welcoming Week programming.

events.title: Levitt Dayton Jazz Fest
events.description: A free evening of jazz closes with headliner the Lao Tizer Band featuring Elliott Yamin, alongside SaxTone Arrington and the Nasty Nati Brass Band on the outdoor stage.

events.title: Dayton Concours d'Elegance Preview Party
events.description: An evening reception among vintage cars kicks off Concours weekend early, giving early arrivals a first look before Sunday's full show floor opens.

events.title: Fifth & Vine Live — 2nd Wind
events.description: Regional cover band 2nd Wind takes the Fifth Third Bank Center Stage for Fountain Square's free Saturday-night concert series, a solid downtown stop before or after Oktoberfest.

events.title: Oktoberfest Zinzinnati
events.address: 705 E Pete Rose Way, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.priceLabel: Free admission; food and drink extra
events.description: The festival's final day wraps up with the same beer tent, Bavarian food, and games, minus the Friday and Saturday night crowds.

events.title: Cincinnati Reds vs. Chicago Cubs
events.description: A getaway-day afternoon matchup closes the Reds-Cubs series with a classic Sunday-at-the-ballpark start time.

events.title: Mariachi El Bronx — You Ese Tour '26
events.description: The mariachi alter-ego of punk band The Bronx brings horn-driven, high-energy Mexican folk music to the Ballroom, with Bedouin Soundclash and Max Diaz opening.

events.title: The Great Gatsby (Broadway in Cincinnati)
events.description: A matinee and an evening performance send off the glittering jazz-age musical's Cincinnati run on its closing Sunday.

events.title: Ohio Renaissance Festival — Pirates Weekend
events.description: The pirate takeover continues into Sunday with rollicking sea shanties, Pirate Play Time, and the giant pirate ship still docked on festival grounds.

events.title: Chico Bean
events.description: A single closing-night set wraps the comedian's three-day Funny Bone run before he heads to the next tour stop.

events.title: The Scandinavian Home: Landscape and Lore (Final Day)
events.description: Last chance to see this exhibit of Nordic landscape paintings, portraits, and decorative arts exploring what "home" meant across five Scandinavian nations — it closes today.

events.title: Findlay Market Sunday
events.description: A quieter, more local-feeling Sunday shopping trip through Ohio's oldest public market, with many merchant stalls and food vendors open on shorter hours.

events.title: A Living Museum of Botanical Splendor
events.description: Close out the weekend among the rainforest and desert rooms plus the conservatory's rotating art-meets-botany fall display.

events.title: Cincinnati Ballet — Kaplan New Works Series
events.description: Catch the world-premiere choreography program before its run wraps up the following weekend — an intimate, visual-art-driven dance bill.

events.title: Dayton Concours d'Elegance
events.description: More than 150 classic and antique cars and motorcycles fill the grounds of this history museum campus for one of the region's premier vintage-auto showcases.

events.title: Covington Farmers Market
events.venue: Covington Farmers Market on Washington Street
events.address: Washington St between W 6th St and W Pike St, Covington, KY 41011
events.description: Regional growers, bakers and makers line Washington Street for a relaxed Saturday-morning market just across the river.

events.title: Festival Latino de Lexington — Friday
events.address: Robert F. Stephens Courthouse Plaza, Lexington, KY 40507
events.description: Downtown Lexington celebrates Latin American culture with live music, dance, visual art and food during Hispanic Heritage Month.

events.title: Festival Latino de Lexington — Saturday
events.address: Robert F. Stephens Courthouse Plaza, Lexington, KY 40507
events.description: The second night of the festival brings more Latin music, dance performances and regional cuisine to the courthouse plaza.

events.title: Circle City Irish Fest — Saturday road trip
events.description: An optional road trip to Indianapolis for a full day of Irish music, dancing, food, vendors and family activities beside Holy Rosary Church.
